name: @gleanwork/mcp-server-tester
stderr:
Usage: mcp-server-tester [options] [command]

CLI tools for MCP server evaluation and testing

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                Initialize a new MCP evaluation project
  generate|gen [options]        Generate eval dataset by interacting with MCP
                                server
  login [options] <server-url>  Authenticate with an MCP server via OAuth
  token [options] <server-url>  Output stored OAuth tokens for CI/CD use
  open [options]                Open the MCP eval reporter UI in your browser
  help [command]                display help for command
